bio: Kyle D. Hawkins serves as Place 7 Justice on the Supreme Court of Texas. The Texas Judicial Branch says he was appointed to the Court in October 2025. RepWatchr treats opinions, orders, rules, and case records as the role-compatible accountability record; it does not substitute legislative roll calls for judicial work. Campaign-finance totals and constituent sentiment remain unrated until their source records pass review.
